0022600166.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, L2, 14th in the East and 5th in the Central, 4 games back) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, L1, 9th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 1 game back) for the Bucks' seventh game of the season, and Milwaukee is 0-2 on the road. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Rudy Gobert (out, back spasms). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
